campaign.author: Pierre H. Vachon
campaign.description: Welcome to the Neo-Imperium of Lankharh - hope you survive! (But wait a second ... instead of the slave that you are now, weren't you an adventurer - in some dream-like life of long ago?)
campaign.name: Wrath of the Mind Lords

restrictions.description: These races are not compatible as PCs for the story of this scenario. Our apologies.

items.description: A magical wrapping capable of binding up to five scrolls.
items.name: Sorcerer Scroll Case

items.description: A magical wrapping capable of binding up to five scrolls.
items.name: Priest Scroll Case

items.description: A magical wrapping capable of binding up to five scrolls.
items.name: Enchanter Scroll Case

items.description: Sturdy shafts that fly straight and true.
items.name: Quiver of Arrows

items.description: A stout stick covered in pitch.
items.name: Torch

items.description: Paper of superior quality needed for the etchings of magical words.
items.name: Parchment

items.description: What they lack in taste they more than make up for in nutrition.
items.name: Iron Rations

items.description: A strong coil make of Hemp and Flax.
items.name: Rope

items.description: A highly polished plate of pure silver.
items.name: Mirror

items.description: Heavy Iron spikes capable of being driven into the hardest of stone.
items.name: Iron Spikes

items.description: In combination with flame this becomes a poor mans fireball.
items.name: Flask of Oil

items.description: A fine wine distilled in the sunken city of Waterford
items.name: Wine

items.description: A finer, sturdier blade.
items.name: Scimitar +2

items.description: The special alloys and magic dweomer of the blade make this sword an efficient weapon indeed.
items.name: Broadsword +3

items.description: A flexible container made of sturdy leather and rendered impermeable; very useful for holding water, especially when one finds oneself lost in an arid region.
items.name: Waterskin

items.description: The magical shield of the dwarven hero Galduur Ironshield. An item that will one day become legend.
items.name: Shield of Galduur

items.description: Ever famous for its taste, its bouquet, its richness and its strenght, even this early in the history of the Sword Lands!
items.name: Dwarven Hall Mead

items.description: Rich, yet not too bitter or too sweet, it is still a far cry from the Wailsrond's rhum of your time!
items.name: Sword Lands Rhum

items.description: Very nice body and bouquet; yet it is meek compared to the Tanirith's wine of your time!
items.name: Sword Lands Wine

items.description: This powerful weapon belonged to the First Captain of the Guards of Mountedge of old, before it became part of the Iron Kingdom.
items.name: Sword of Nymos

items.description: Perfectly cut, these rubies are sought for their value and their beauty.
items.name: Dwarven Ruby Stone

items.description: Crafted by a master bowyer and enchanted with dweomers to make it aim farther and better.
items.name: Bow +2

items.description: Rare indeed, these bows combine the best craftmanship and dweomercraft to make them deadly in the hands of any archer.
items.name: Bow +3

items.description: The weapon of choice of Keryndorhyan Psi-Knights, it can wound not only the flesh but the mind as well.
items.name: Psi-Blade

items.description: This fantastic bow was created ages ago by a ranger of Anarym, who's name remains a mystery in the Realmz.
items.name: Longbow Hunter

items.description: Forged and crafted by fire giant masters, these armors not only protect against the cold but also provide a boon against the undead.
items.name: Firebrand Armor

items.description: The miner's tool ... or a weapon for the desperate.
items.name: Mining Pick

items.description: Forged and crafted by frost giant masters, these armors not only protect against fire but also provide a boon against denizens of Hell and the Abyss.
items.name: Frostbrand Armor

items.description: The first blade of this type was created centuries past by Nelecktran, the first electromancer.
items.name: Shocker

items.description: Some say these helms were made ages ago to combat warriors with psionic powers.
items.name: Helm of Id

items.description: It is said that he who wears this helm shall have the contentment of the simpleton.
items.name: Helm of Duncea

items.description: A magnificent shield made of mithril, it is a boon for selfless paladins and crusaders.
items.name: Shield of the Crusader

items.description: The curse of a medusa shall be inflicted on he/she who wears this suit of armor.
items.name: Medusa Armor

items.description: A legendary item in the eyes of Mayaltecs, this shield belonged to the very first mayaltec Highking, Turoac.
items.name: Turoac's Shield

items.description: A superb weapon with a powerful dweomer; unfortunately, it turns its owner into a coward.
items.name: Sword of Kowart

items.description: An armor much sought after by psionicists and psi-warriors.
items.name: Psi-Armor

items.description: This magnificent blade has but one purpose only: to slay anything reptilian, including dragons.
items.name: Scalesbreaker

items.description: These shields were used ages ago against warriors with psionic powers.
items.name: Ironwill

items.description: The symbol of mayaltec rulership passed down from one Highking to the next, ever since the ascension of the first Highking, Turoac.
items.name: Tiara of the Lost Highkings

items.description: The preferred blade of assassins and murderers for hire.
items.name: Fang

items.description: A fantastic dwarven battleaxe, usually given to dwarven heroes.
items.name: Firestorm

items.description: Light, yet sturdy and of high quality; made of mithril and special dwarven alloys: very well suited by and for its makers.
items.name: Dwarven Chain Mail

items.description: The regular weapon of dwarven warriors.
items.name: Dwarven Cutter

items.description: Magically reinforced boots, yet as comfortable as regular leather boots.
items.name: Traveler's Boots

items.description: A shield for heroes ... dwarven ones, that is.
items.name: Moradin's Wall

items.description: A blade made on the continent of Anarym, nothing is known of this wonderful sword.
items.name: Dwarven Wrath

items.description: A much sought after item by psionicists.
items.name: Psi Bracers

items.description: A robe much sought after by psionicists.
items.name: Robe of the Psion

items.description: A terrible item used by slavers to break the will of their slaves.
items.name: Slaver's Bracers

items.description: Usually a gift offered by enemies to break one's will.
items.name: Cloak of Willingness

items.description: He/she who wears this shall be confused by the world around him/her.
items.name: Cap of Confusion

items.description: A reinforced leather cap.
items.name: Cap of Defense

items.description: The processed pelt of a silverback wolf; great for clothing and warming. Also very valuable when sold.
items.name: Silverback Furcloak

items.description: An exquisite blade forged out of a mithril-adamandine alloy. Very sharp and deadly too.
items.name: Two-Handed Sword +5

items.description: The processed pelt of an animal; great for clothing and warming. Also valuable when sold.
items.name: Animal Furcloak

items.description: This beautiful ring allows its wearer to fear no lightning.
items.name: Insulation Ring

items.description: Made of mithril and adamandine, this terrible weapon shreds both the flesh and the mind of its victims.
items.name: Psi-Axe

items.description: Well-balanced daggers that bear a strong dweomer to increase their accuracy.
items.name: Throwing Daggers +3

items.description: A rod useful to help one get out fast of those dead-end situations.
items.name: Rod of Teleportation

items.description: This exquisite armor is forged with adamandine, the rare metal that's stronger than mithril.
items.name: Adamandine Armor

items.description: Not much is known of this item which was created centuries ago on the continent of Anarym, except that its wielder is given powers to influence and rule others.
items.name: Mace of Rulership

items.description: This superb armor was forged in endurinium, the rarest of metals that surpasses even mithril and adamandine.
items.name: Endurinium Armor

items.description: A superb blade for the true warrior.
items.name: Two Handed Sword +3

items.description: A battlestaff rumored to contain live electricity and lightning. Obviously designed for electromancers.
items.name: Staff of Discharge

items.description: Made of a special mithril-steel alloy, this blade will cut true and through.
items.name: Battleaxe +2

items.description: A magnificent shield made of mithril, it is a boon for devout servants of the Gods in their fight against the undead.
items.name: Shield of Faith

items.description: A terrible magic item which will turn its possessor into a frigid statue of the coldest of ice.
items.name: Ring of Icing Doom

items.description: Seemingly comfortable, these boots have hidden needles which inject the deadliest of poisons, killing their wearer instantly.
items.name: Boots of the Black Widow

items.description: This terrible weapon is known to render helpless any victim hit by its bloodthirsty blade.
items.name: Dread Holder

items.description: A shield made of mithril-steel, it bestows many gifts to the warrior brave of heart against any enemy and monsters.
items.name: Braveheart

items.description: Legends say that this weapon was forged eons ago by Shanarack, God of Winter. This item will shrink or expand according to the size of its wielder, thus being usable by any warrior.
items.name: Mulgorh

items.description: A better, sharper shortsword, bearing strong dweomers to enhance its efficiency.
items.name: Short Sword +2

items.description: For brawny mages, this wonderful weapon enhances its owner's attacks.
items.name: Double Dealer

items.description: A very beneficial hat for any traveling minstrel.
items.name: Muse of the Balladeer

items.description: A magnificent blade, this sword inflicts damage almost like a two-handed sword but is wielded like a broadsword.
items.name: Bastard Sword +4

items.description: Blessed by the Goddess of Life, Lharishar, for those deserving of her kindly boon.
items.name: Lharishar's Heart

items.description: These rare scrolls store the spell "destroy magic".
items.name: Nullmagic

items.description: It is said that he/she who studies the writings of such a book shall gain greater knowledge.
items.name: Tome of Logic

items.description: A magical tome who's perusal causes an increase of vitality to the reader.
items.name: Treatise on Health

items.description: A magical tome for priestly castes whose secrets will enlighten its reader.
items.name: Tome of the Devout

items.description: Truly a most prized boon for any true spellweaver.
items.name: Ring of the Spellweaver

items.description: Fear the touch of the God of Death and Murder ...
items.name: Kharalkuur's Touch

items.description: It is said that he (or she) who wears this terrible cloak shall never need fear death ...
items.name: Cloak of the Wraith

items.description: What good can come out of a gift from the God of Disease, Decay and Corruption?
items.name: Decanther's Gift

items.description: A failed ion stone. Although it provides some slight benefits, it renders one low of wits and intellect.
items.name: Emerald Stone +5

items.description: These terrible gloves are said to have been 'blessed' by Orcas, God of Undeath, Horrors and Terror.
items.name: Undeath's Kiss

items.description: These magnificent gloves once belonged to the monk Yuriko Moonjade, known for being able to electrocute her opponents with a touch.
items.name: Yukio's Hands

items.description: A warhelm fabled among orcish tribes, it is said to bestow untold powers to those orcs that are true warriors by the standard of their peers.
items.name: Horns of Blood

items.description: Another example of splendid dwarven craftmanship, this crossbow is better than any other normal crossbow.
items.name: Dwarven Crossbow

items.description: Another example of splendid elven craftmanship, this missile weapon easily outmatches any of its kind.
items.name: Elven Crossbow

items.description: Rumored to have been blessed by Miellakkar, Goddess of the Forests, this quiver is a great boon to the archer/ranger caste.
items.name: Quiver of the Forest

items.description: A superb example of gnomish craftmanship, this is the epitome of leather-type armors.
items.name: Gnomish Armor

items.description: Unrefined ore freshly mined.
items.name: Mined Ore

items.description: Uncut and unrefined valuable stones freshly mined.
items.name: Rough Gemstones

items.description: An uncut and unrefined valuable stone freshly mined.
items.name: Rough Gemstone

items.description: An uncut and unrefined very valuable stone freshly mined.
items.name: Rough Precious Stone

items.description: A very rare item highly prized by alchemists and mages -its rarity comes more from the obvious, terrible dangers one must face to acquire one!
items.name: Dragon Egg

items.description: A superb armor of mithril-adamandine alloy, much lighter than its normal counterpart.
items.name: Elven Chain Armor

items.description: When donned, this marvelous cloak will confer camouflage powers, as well as other special attributes.
items.name: Elven Cloak

items.description: A magnificent unique bastard sword, it is said to protect its wielder as much as it helps him wound his opponents.
items.name: Guardian

items.description: An old armor worn by the most prestigious descendants of the royal Nuramin Dynasty.
items.name: Armor of the Nuramin

items.description: A magnificent stone, perfectly cut ... and perfectly valuable too.
items.name: Diamond Stone

items.description: A relic which will allow the True Gods to protect the faithful against the probings of the Mentarchs.
items.name: Book of Powers

items.description: A key that will fit the lock of a very specific door.
items.name: Portal Key

items.description: A present-day lexicon about the Sword Lands of the year circa 529 R.R. Just click "Use" to peruse its contents.
items.name: Lexicon

items.description: A magical trans-temporal teleportation device which allows your swift return to the Towers of the Hourglass.
items.name: Stone of Recall

items.description: An artifact from the fabled empire of Telluria, the purpose of this strange object remains a puzzle.
items.name: Tellurian Electro-key

items.description: Your typical leather pouch made to hang on a belt and to hold coins. Just click "Use" in order to partake of its contents!
items.name: Money Pouch

items.description: A used map you found on one of the highwaymen that attempted to ambush you. Just click "Use" if you want to look it over.
items.name: Crumbled Map
